title: Cardinality of a singleton subtype
statement: For any type $\alpha$ and element $a\in\alpha$, if the subtype of elements of $\alpha$ belonging to the singleton $\{a\}$ is finite, then it has cardinality $1$.
hypotheses_covered: The singleton subtype has a finite-type structure
replaced:
For any type $\alpha$ and element $a \in \alpha$, the subtype $\{x : \alpha \mid x \in \{a\}\}$
has cardinality exactly $1$, for any \texttt{Fintype} instance on that subtype.
